PANEL_FAMILIES.doc: The panel families of a plugin (omx-panel docs/panel-layout.md): the kind of processor its panel is laid out for. The words and their order are the contract; omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs FAMILIES and the skin package schema read them, and keep their code.
PANEL_FAMILIES.why: Panel families and widgets are declarations, so they live here (vocabulary-owner rule, FreeMixer/omx-contract#157).

none.doc: a plugin with no family: its panel is laid out from its groups and roles

text.en: A plugin with no family: its panel is laid out from its groups and its roles.
A gate's or an expander's panel family.
A compressor's panel family.
A limiter's panel family.
A de-esser's panel family.
An equaliser's panel family, parametric or graphic.
A filter's panel family.
A saturator's or a distortion's panel family.

modulation.doc: a chorus, flanger, phaser or tremolo

text.en: A chorus's, a flanger's, a phaser's or a tremolo's panel family.
A delay's panel family.
A reverb's panel family.
A pitch shifter's panel family.

utility.doc: a gain trim, a stereo width control or another utility that shapes a signal without a processor's character

text.en: A utility's panel family: a trim, a width control, a balancer or a clipper.

PANEL_STANDARD_WIDGETS.doc: The standard widgets a panel picks from a descriptor and a representation (a skin) draws, in the order omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs STANDARD_WIDGETS lists them.

text.en: A travel, drawn as a knob.
A travel drawn long, as a fader.
A toggle, drawn as a switch.

selector.doc: an integer travel or labelled values

text.en: An integer travel or labelled values, drawn as a selector.
A readout, drawn as a meter.
A response or transfer curve, drawn as a graph.

xy.doc: two controls drawn as one point

text.en: Two controls drawn together as one point on a plane.
A value shown as text.

PANEL_WIDGETS.doc: The widgets a declared panel may name for a control, and the extension serves (org.openmixer.panel-description/1): auto leaves the choice to the panel layout. The four others are the shared widgets of omx-panel's schema/panel.schema.json.

auto.doc: left out of a panel declaration: the layout picks the widget from the control

text.en: Left out of a panel declaration: the layout picks the widget from the control.
A rotary control.
A linear control.
A two-state control.

selector.doc: a control that picks one of a few values

text.en: A control that picks one of a few values.

PANEL_DISPLAY_KINDS.doc: The displays a declared panel may carry, and the extension serves (org.openmixer.panel-description/1), in the order of their codes: a panel description names a display by its place here. omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs and omx-clap-core's panel tables read them, and keep their code.
PANEL_DISPLAY_KINDS.why: omx-clap-core restated these words by hand beside the families and widgets; a display kind is a declaration, so it lives here (vocabulary-owner rule).

gainReductionBar.doc: a bar of the gain a dynamics processor takes off

text.en: A bar showing the gain reduction.

transferCurve.doc: a dynamics processor's output level against its input level

text.en: The dynamics transfer curve: output level against input level.
The equaliser's frequency response.
A level meter.

timeResponse.doc: a response over time: a delay's train of taps or a reverb's decay envelope

text.en: The response over time: a delay's taps or a reverb's decay.

PANEL_DISPLAY_SOURCES.doc: Where a panel description's display takes its data from, in the order of their codes (org.openmixer.panel-description/1). omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs and omx-clap-core's panel tables read them, and keep their code.
PANEL_DISPLAY_SOURCES.why: omx-clap-core and omx-plugins restated these words by hand beside the families, widgets and display kinds; a display source is a declaration, so it lives here (vocabulary-owner rule).

family.doc: the data the panel family itself implies

text.en: The data the panel family implies.
The plugin's meter readouts.
The gain the processor applies.
A curve the plugin declares.

PANEL_PLACEMENTS.doc: Where an instance sits, in the order of their codes: the clap.track-info/1 flags read as one value (org.openmixer.panel-description/1). omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs and omx-clap-core's panel tables read them, and keep their code.
PANEL_PLACEMENTS.why: omx-clap-core and omx-plugins restated these words by hand; a placement is a declaration, so it lives here (vocabulary-owner rule).

insert.doc: an instance on a track's insert chain

text.en: An instance on an insert chain.

return.doc: an instance on a return track

text.en: An instance on a return track.
An instance on a bus.
An instance on the master.
